claims.reason: Passage 3 states Jack Lindsey leads the model psychiatry team, his paper shows limited functional introspective awareness that is highly limited and context-dependent, and he is arguably the most direct researcher on metacognition.
Passage 4 states Chris Olah and Josh Batson work on circuit-tracing research and their publications are the main source for mechanistic explanations of hallucination.
Passage 5 exactly matches the claim about Sam Marks' work on geometry of truth and auditing hidden objectives.
Passage 7 identifies Sebastian Farquhar and Yarin Gal as lead authors of the semantic entropy method published in Nature 2024 for detecting confabulations.
Passage 8 says Adam Tauman Kalai is lead author of the 2025 paper, but claim says co‑authored, losing the lead author qualification.
Passage 9 says Owain Evans co-authored early work on teaching models to express uncertainty, but claim says he has done influential work on that, overstating his role.
Passage 11 confirms Stephen Fleming is a leading neuroscientist, author of Know Thyself, applies metacognition to AI, and clarifies calibration-versus-discrimination.
Passage 13 confirms Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor wrote the agent reliability paper borrowing from nuclear/aviation safety and produce a skeptical data-driven newsletter.
Passage 14 confirms METR founded by Beth Barnes measures autonomous task completion and is a key reference for reliability-over-horizon.
Passage 15 describes Andrej Karpathy popularizing the march of nines framing; claim kind is announcement but passage is factual, so wrong_kind.
Passage 16 confirms Azalia Mirhoseini co-led LLM-as-a-Verifier work on scaling verification.
Passage 18 describes Shreya Shankar's research on evaluating LLM pipelines and the Who Validates the Validators paper; claim kind is how-to but passage is factual, so wrong_kind.
Passage 19 describes Hamel Husain as a practical voice on building evals; claim kind is how-to but passage is factual, so wrong_kind.
Passage 20 describes Eugene Yan writing accessible practical pieces; claim kind is how-to but passage is factual, so wrong_kind.
Passage 22 recommends a minimal set of sources to follow and arXiv search terms, matching the claim's how-to advice.

review.summary: Reviewed 15 claims against 22 passages. 10 claims fully supported. 5 claims need revision: claim 5 misstates lead author as co-author (lost_qualification), claim 6 overstates role in teaching uncertainty (lost_qualification), claims 10, 12, 13, 14 have wrong_kind (should be fact not announcement/how-to). No duplicates. All central researcher contributions covered; omitted_concepts empty.
